content.stem: A国的反腐败机构一直在调查可能的贿赂和腐败所得向B国转移的情况,目前正准备将此案提交当地法院审理.哪种获取起诉该案所需证据的方法最为有效？

options.A: 直接由A国反腐败机构负责人向B国相应执法机构提出正式请求
options.B: 依据A国与B国之间的司法互助条约,提出获取所需证据的请求
options.C: 利用国际刑事警察组织(国际刑警组织)的网络从B国获取所需的证据
options.D: 通过埃格蒙特安全网络从B国金融情报机构获取所需证据

content.stem_en: Country A's anti-corruption authority has been investigating the movement of potential proceeds of bribery and corruption to Country B and is now preparing to take the case to a local court. Which method of obtaining the required evidence to prosecute the case would be most effective?

options_en.A: Make an official request directly from the head of Country A's anti-corruption authority to Country B's corresponding law enforcement authority
options_en.B: Make a request for the required evidence using the mutual legal assistance treaty between Country A and Country B
options_en.C: Use the International Criminal Police Organization (INTERPOL) network to obtain the required evidence from Country B
options_en.D: Obtain the required evidence from Country B's Financial Intelligence Unit through the Egmont Secure Web
